body:
Aniracetam w/ Pyritinol, Picamilon
I received my shipment of nootropics in the mail.
22:10 --1500mg Aniracetam
600mg Glycerylphosphorylcholine
400mg Pyritinol
300mg Picamilon
22:30 --.25g Cannabis indica smoked
I was originally going to do a couple of baseline tests with some memory games before dosing myself, but I got excited and couldnt wait to try the Aniracetam.  Also, I had wanted to be free and clear of Cannabis for a few weeks before beginning the nootropics trials, but its hard for me to stay quit for that long at a time lately.  In fact, I couldnt wait for a couple of hours to see if I perceived any effects from the nootropics before smoking a bowl tonight.
22:50
I feel like Im beginning to feel a little more focused.  Visually, colors seem a little brighter, more full.  I put the mostly smoked bowl away, and am kind of annoyed with myself for partaking so often that it clouds my mind.  The whole point of the nootropics trials is to sharpen my mind and memory.
02:20
Ive been writing for a couple of hours now, which is something that I usually dont have the attention span for.  No dramatic effects, but I was kind of in the zone with my writing, I guess.  And I havent had any herbs for almost 4 hours, which is a long time for me when Im just sitting in front of the computer.  It feels good to have my Morning Glory report done.  But I am feeling pretty tired, and its time to go to bed.  I will attribute the increased attention span and motivation to the nootropic cocktail.
I did not feel any side effects during this experience.
